messages:
alex: Huge thank you to @li and @tanya for hunting down that embedding drift this morning — caught a bad tokenization edge that would've hit search results. seriously saved our demo flow :sparkles:
tanya: ack! it was a weird unicode case. thanks @alex for the forensic logs, made the pattern obvious
li: team work. patch landed and I kicked off a quick eval run, numbers look normal now :chart_with_upwards_trend:
chuck: also shoutout to @zara in product for validating the user repro steps so we could test locally fast
zara: happy to help, and big props to @katie from infra for spinning a small dev cluster on short notice :muscle:
katie: no prob, cluster was fast. also, i'm claiming the honor of providing celebratory iced tea tomorrow 3pm — who wants? :tea:
alex: i'm in. snacks welcome too :yum:
thanks-bot: Reminder: Kitchen table reserved 14:45-15:15 by #random for small team gathering
tanya: love the quick celebration. thanks everyone for the hustle :heart:
_meta_note: Single-thread Slack convo in #random. Messages are chronological, prefixed with sender names, include short replies, emoji, a bot note, and a light in-person follow-up. No title per agents.md.
